item.title: Cedar Creek southpaw heads to Hinds

item.title: Bail jumper found on foot on Interstate 20
item.description: A DeQuincy man was arrested by Lincoln Parish deputies after they responded to the report of a person walking in traffic on Interstate 20 Wednesday evening.
